class.name: OcgXcafdocLayertool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (Layers) of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document A Document is intended to hold different attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes Provide tools for management of Layers section of document.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (Layers) ! of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document ! A Document is intended to hold different ! attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes ! Provide tools for management of Layers section of document.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which Layers are stored

method.name: IsLayer
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a Layertable and is a Layer definition

method.name: SetLayer_1
method.description: Sets a link from label <L> to Layer defined by <LayerL> optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one.

method.name: UnSetLayers_1
method.description: Removes a link from label <L> to all layers

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_2
method.description: Remove link from label <L> and Layer <aLayerL>. returns FALSE if <aLayerL> is not a layer label.

method.name: IsSet_2
method.description: Returns True if label <L> has a Layer associated with the <aLayerL> label.

method.name: IsVisible
method.description: Return TRUE if layer is visible, FALSE if invisible.

method.name: SetVisibility
method.description: Set the visibility of layer. If layer is invisible when on it's layer will set UAttribute with corresponding GUID.

method.name: SetLayer_3
method.description: Sets a link from label that containing shape <Sh> with layer that situated at label <LayerL>. optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one. return FALSE if no such shape <Sh> or label <LayerL>

method.name: UnSetLayers_2
method.description: Remove link between shape <Sh> and all Layers at LayerTable. return FALSE if no such shape <Sh> in XCAF Document.

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_4
method.description: Remove link between shape <Sh> and layer <aLayerL>. returns FALSE if no such layer <aLayerL> or shape <Sh>.

method.name: IsSet_4
method.description: Returns True if shape <Sh> has a Layer associated with the <aLayerL>.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
